calls.video_title: Unfortunate News for Micron Stock and Sandisk Stock Investors | MU Stock | SNDK Stock
calls.price_at_call: FV $1,662 (stated); ~11-12% upside stated, stock down 6% on the day; current price not stated
calls.thesis: First tracked SNDK call. Same CXMT dip update with a refreshed FV: SNDK looks fairly valued to slightly undervalued — a buying opportunity only for higher-risk-tolerant investors; he prefers MU (and TSM/NVDA) for a larger margin of safety.
calls.base_case: Slight undervaluation: ~11-12% to his $1,662 fair value.
calls.bear_case: Margin of safety thinner than he likes for a name he views as somewhat riskier than MU.

calls.thesis: 'Pantry' memory for AI workloads; sales +175% to ~$20B, expected to double again, ~7x next-year earnings — market is pricing the bust as if it's already here. DCA because of volatility.
calls.bull_case: Data-center spend on SanDisk up ~14x YoY with ~$91B of signed multi-year contracts; memory may be structurally less cyclical this cycle.
calls.bear_case: Growth was mostly price hikes on 2/3 legacy business (phones/PCs/cards); long-term contracts cover only a quarter to a third of next year's sales; big funds cut ~30%.
